assumptions.note: ASSUMED, not observed, on the 12-month horizon of the label. Margin = 12-month net interest margin after funding and servicing cost on a GOOD loan, as % of principal; a BAD loan (90+ DPD inside 12 months, so most principal still outstanding) loses EAD x LGD x principal. Flat pricing: LendingClub risk-based pricing is ignored; losses after month 12 are not in the label.
